name: Sister Hiti

abilities.name: Ice Tornado
abilities.description: She summons a large ice tornado, indicated by a large circular AoE, that will swirl around the arena in your general direction, dealing continuous high frost damage while inside and snaring you.

abilities.name: Flame Swirl
abilities.description: She summons a fire swirl that tracks your movement as it builds up, before erupting, dealing very high flame damage. After the eruption, a pool of flame will continue to follow your movement for a few more seconds, dealing continuous high flame damage that must be healed through.

abilities.name: Summon Undead
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, Envervating Thralls will constantly appear in the arena to join the fight.

abilities.name: Thunderous Pursuit
abilities.description: She calls forth fourteen lightning strikes to hit you, all chaining quickly one after the other as indicated by small circular AoEs, dealing high shock damage each.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: I knew this ritual would bring trouble. Your new patron asks too much of us!
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Hiti and Sister Skelga will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Enough of your mewling! These slow-witted Nords pose little threat.
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Hiti and Sister Skelga will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Look here. More of them! Stay out of my way, Hiti.
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Hiti and Sister Skelga will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: I do as I please, sister!
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Hiti and Sister Skelga will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Step aside, Skelga. I'll burn them alive!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight Hiti will use her fire magic, uncaring if it inadvertently gets in the way of Skelga's own attacks. When this happens, the pair will argue. Both characters have a pool of dialogue lines which are randomly chosen

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Your flames are a blight shrew. Go join the rest of your coven.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Skelga? Skelga! You … I'll burn you to cinders for this!
dialogue.trigger: Once you kill Skelga, Hiti will swear vengeance before teleporting away.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: They killed Skelga! Right in front of me!
dialogue.trigger: Sister Hiti is encountered again as you reach the courtyard where the storm ritual is being performed.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Gohlla
dialogue.line: Settle, Hiti. You'll disturb the ritual! It must be perfect. Isn't that right, mother?
dialogue.trigger: Sister Hiti is encountered again as you reach the courtyard where the storm ritual is being performed.

dialogue.line: Mother Ciannait "It is, dear one. Our patron's terms were fair, Hiti. If we wish to reap the reward, we must deliver what he desires."
dialogue.trigger: Sister Hiti is encountered again as you reach the courtyard where the storm ritual is being performed.

related_quests: The Frozen Isle: Brave the island of Icereach and look for survivors.
Pledge: Icereach: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Icereach.
summary: Sister Hiti is a member of the Icereach Coven who specializes in fire magic. She can be found on their island home of Icereach. She is involved in the final boss fight of the dungeon, assisting Mother Ciannait, alongside her sisters Bani, Gohlla and Maefyn.
